skateboards_board_desc: A wooden deck on iron trucks and resin wheels. Hold it and attack to drop it and hop on. W pushes, S brakes, A and D carve, hold Jump and let go to ollie, E steps off.
skateboards_skill_description: Pushing, popping and landing tricks on a skateboard. Pushes get you up to {push100}% faster, ollies pop higher, spins go from {spin0} to {spin100} degrees a second, flips are quicker and grinds and manuals steadier.
skateboards_too_heavy: Too heavy to skate: you carry too much.
skateboards_hint_start: On the board! Hold W to push where the camera looks (Shift: harder), S brakes, A and D turn. Hold Jump and let go to ollie. E steps off.
skateboards_hint_air: In the air: A and D spin. Land with the board pointing the way you go (nose or tail first).
skateboards_hint_tricks: Tricks: Attack is a flip (twice for a double), hold Block for a grab; the move key you hold picks which one. Land straight for a Perfect.
skateboards_hint_grind: Grinding! Keep the needle in the middle with A and D. Jump to ollie off.
skateboards_hint_manual: Manual! Keep the needle in the middle with W and S. It links your tricks into one combo.
skateboards_rail_desc: A 4 m iron-capped rail half a metre up. Ollie onto it on a skateboard to grind it.
skateboards_ledge_desc: A stone box with iron edges. Ollie onto an edge on a skateboard to grind along it.
skateboards_kicker_desc: A short curved launch ramp. Roll up it on a skateboard and fly.
skateboards_quarterpipe_desc: A curved ramp that turns straight up, with a deck and an iron coping on top. Roll up it on a skateboard for a vert air; two facing each other make a half pipe.
skateboards_hint_special: Special meter full: you go faster. Specials: A then W, then Attack (Ragnarök Flip); D then S, then Block (Valkyrie Air); D then S just before a rail (Bifröst Grind).
skateboards_hint_revert: Revert! Crouch right after landing on a ramp keeps the combo going; hold it into a manual.
skateboards_keys_roll:
<color=#FFD27F>W</color> push where the camera looks   <color=#FFD27F>S</color> brake
<color=#FFD27F>A D</color> turn (slow: spin round)
<color=#FFD27F>hold Jump</color>, let go: ollie
<color=#FFD27F>hold Crouch</color>: manual   <color=#FFD27F>E</color>: step off
skateboards_keys_air:
<color=#FFD27F>A D</color> spin (let go: it lands straight)
<color=#FFD27F>Attack</color> flip   <color=#FFD27F>hold Block</color> grab
hold <color=#FFD27F>W S A D</color> as you press: a different trick
land on a rail, wall top or edge: grind
skateboards_keys_grind:
<color=#FFD27F>A D</color> keep the needle in the middle
<color=#FFD27F>Jump</color>: ollie off
skateboards_keys_manual:
<color=#FFD27F>W S</color> keep the needle in the middle
let go of <color=#FFD27F>Crouch</color>: roll on   <color=#FFD27F>Jump</color>: ollie
skateboards_keys_special: <color=#FFD27F>SPECIAL</color>: tap A, W, then Attack · tap D, S, then Block
